long.label: Packing-line problem
long.reference_text: Packing line-la conveyor romba fast-aa odudhu. Box-ellaam keezha vizhudhu. Speed-ai konjam kammi pannalaam-nu, motor-ku pora voltage-ai kammi pannaanga. Motor konjam slow aachu. Aana irupadhu nimishathula, motor-la irundhu pugai varudhu. Thappu enga?
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Home regulator analogy
long.reference_text: Ivanga idea veetla irundhu vandhadhu. Veetla fan regulator-ai kammi pannaa, fan slow aagudhu, onnum aagaradhu illa. Regulator pannradhu, voltage-ai kammi pannradhu dhaan. Adhey trick-ai conveyor motor-la pannaanga.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Fan versus conveyor load
long.reference_text: Aana rendukkum oru periya vidhyaasam irukku. Fan thalla vendiyadhu kaathu mattum dhaan, load romba kammi. Conveyor motor box-ellaam thookkitu odanum, load romba adhigam.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Voltage reduction: torque,slip,current,heat
long.reference_text: Voltage kammi aanaa, motor-oda torque kammi aagudhu. Aana box load adhey dhaan. Andha load-ai thalla mudiyaama motor slip adhigam aagudhu. Slip adhigam aanaa, current mela poguthu. Adhigama current, winding-ai soodaakkudhu. Irupadhu nimishathula insulation erinju, pugai varudhu.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Frequency decides speed
long.reference_text: Appo voltage motor speed-ai control pannala. Speed-ai unmaiyaa decide pannradhu, supply-oda frequency.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Stator currents and rotating magnetic field
long.reference_text: Motor ulla stator-la moonu phase winding irukku. Moonu phase current maari maari varumbodhu, ulla oru magnetic field sutthudhu. Rotor andha field-ai follow panni sutthudhu. Field evlo vegama sutthudho, rotor-um adhey vegathula sutthum.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: 120f/p formula,1500 synchronous /1440 rated
long.reference_text: Field-oda vegatha frequency dhaan decide pannudhu. Formula: speed sama, nooru-irubadhu into frequency, divided by poles. Fifty hertz, naalu pole motor-na, aayirathu-ainnooru RPM. Load-oda konjam slip irukkum, adhanaala nameplate-la aayirathu-naanooru-naarpadhu RPM.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: 25Hz quiz and options
long.reference_text: Ungalukku oru question. Idhey motor-ku irupathi-anju hertz kudutha, speed evlo? A, aayirathu-ainnooru. B, ezhunooru-aimbadhu. C, moovaayiram. Answer-ai manasula vechukonga, VFD ulla poi paarthadhum check pannalaam.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Need for VFD
long.reference_text: Aana EB supply eppovume fifty hertz dhaan. Adha namma maatha mudiyaadhu. Adhanaala motor-kkum supply-kkum naduvula oru device venum. Fifty hertz-ai vaangi, namakku venumgira frequency-la pudhu supply kudukkanum. Adhu dhaan VFD, Variable Frequency Drive.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Three stages
long.reference_text: VFD-ku ulla moonu stage irukku.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Rectifier
long.reference_text: Mudhal stage, rectifier. EB-la irundhu vara moonu phase AC-ai, diodes vechu DC-aa maathudhu. DC-la frequency-ye kidaiyaadhu. Fifty hertz anga mudinjidudhu.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: DC bus
long.reference_text: Rendavadhu stage, DC bus. Rectifier kudukkura DC-la ripple irukkum. Periya capacitors adha smooth pannudhu. Four-fifteen volt supply-ku, DC bus kitta thatta ainnooru-arubadhu volt.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: IGBT inverter / PWM
long.reference_text: Moonaavadhu stage, inverter. IGBT-nu solra fast switches, oru second-ku aayira kanakkula ON, OFF aagudhu. Pulse-oda width-ai maathi maathi kudukkumbodhu, motor-ku adhu oru sine wave maadhiri theriyum. Idhu dhaan PWM.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Changing output frequency /25Hz setting
long.reference_text: Indha switching pattern-ai slow pannaa, sine wave-um slow aagudhu, frequency kammi. Fast pannaa, frequency adhigam. Ippo VFD-la irupathi-anju hertz set pannuvom.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Half-speed field /750RPM / answerB
long.reference_text: Stator-la field paadhi vegathula sutthudhu. Rotor-um paadhi vegam. Nooru-irubadhu into irupathi-anju, divided by naalu, ezhunooru-aimbadhu RPM. Unga answer B-aa irundhaa, correct.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Frequency-only reduction: overflux/heat caveat
long.reference_text: Aana frequency-ai mattum kammi pannaa, innoru problem varum. Winding oru coil. Frequency kammi aanaa, coil-oda reactance kammi aagudhu. Adhey four-fifteen volt kuduthaa, current romba adhigam aagi, core saturate aagudhu. Thirumba motor soodaagum.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: V/F ratio
long.reference_text: Adhanaala VFD, frequency-oda sendhu voltage-aiyum kammi pannudhu. Fifty hertz-ku four-fifteen volt-na, oru hertz-ku kitta thatta ettu-punnu-moonu volt. Irupathi-anju hertz-ku, kitta thatta irunooru-ezhu volt. Volt-um hertz-um orey ratio-la irundhaa, torque full-aa irukkum. Idhu dhaan V by F control.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset

long.label: Conveyor comparison
long.reference_text: Ippo andha conveyor-ku thirumba povom. Voltage mattum kammi pannappo, torque poi, current yeri, motor pugaichu. VFD vechu frequency-um voltage-um sendhu kammi pannaa, speed kammi aagudhu, torque full-aa irukku, current normal. Box vizhala, motor-um soodaagala.
long.timing_status: machine-aligned scene cue, not verified phoneme onset
